opening.argument: The interview presents OneCoin as “a real deal” and urges people seeking a challenge to pursue its industry as a path to becoming the next millionaire. It promotes rapid registration growth as proof of opportunity, claiming, “there is a reason that 420,000 people already registered in 8 month. We are the fastest growing network company in the world.” The structure described is recruitment-dependent: “if you have relationship with the leaders, so your sponsor or your mentor,” while “Network marketing is about relationships.” Rank-based rewards add further incentive, promising, “They will receive their iPhones, they will receive their MacBooks.” The interview promotes participation without investigating or criticizing the offer.
